entries.author: teacher
entries.content: Done. Root cause: `RDSBackend.delete_db_cluster` in `moto/rds/models.py` removed a cluster unconditionally (only checking deletion protection), even when the cluster still had member DB instances. Fix: before deleting, it now checks `cluster.cluster_members` and raises `InvalidDBClusterStateFault` ("Cluster cannot be deleted, it still contains DB instances in non-deleting state.") — matching real AWS behavior. Once the instances are deleted (which removes them from `cluster_members`), cluster deletion succeeds. Verified with a reproduction script and the existing RDS test suite (clusters, clusters-with-instances, CloudFormation, global clusters, and main RDS tests all pass).
